author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A golden crust on the outside, rich pilaf on the inside — this is the magic of Turkish Perde Pilav 🔥🌾 In this video, we prepare this beautiful dish where fragrant rice and tender meat are wrapped in dough and baked to perfection.

As it cooks, the outer layer turns crispy and golden, sealing in all the аромат flavors inside. When sliced, it reveals a warm, savory filling that’s both comforting and impressive.

Perde Pilav is more than just a dish — it’s a tradition. Known for its unique presentation and rich taste, it’s often made for special occasions, combining simple ingredients with a truly unforgettable result.
title: Crispy Outside, Pilaf Inside — Turkish Perde Pilav 🔥🌾
